title: Add Observability Protocol: Logging, Metrics, Tracing
body:
Implements comprehensive observability protocols for structured logging, metrics collection, and distributed tracing to enable production-grade monitoring across ObjectStack components.

## Logging Protocol (`logging.zod.ts`)

- **Multi-destination routing**: Console, file, HTTP, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Loki, Kafka, Redis
- **Structured enrichment**: Static/dynamic fields, trace correlation, caller context, host metadata
- **Advanced features**: Sampling, buffering, rotation, redaction, per-destination filtering

```typescript
const config: LoggingConfig = {
  name: 'production_logging',
  destinations: [
    { type: 'console', level: 'info' },
    { 
      type: 'http', 
      http: { 
        url: 'https://logs.example.com',
        batch: { maxSize: 500, flushInterval: 5000 }
      }
    }
  ],
  enrichment: {
    staticFields: { environment: 'production' },
    addCaller: true
  }
};
```

## Metrics Protocol (`metrics.zod.ts`)

- **Prometheus-compatible types**: Counter, Gauge, Histogram, Summary
- **Time-series primitives**: Data points, aggregations (sum/avg/min/max/p50/p95/p99)
- **SLI/SLO framework**: Error budgets, burn rate alerts, compliance tracking
- **Export targets**: Prometheus, OpenMetrics, InfluxDB, StatsD, Datadog, CloudWatch

```typescript
const slo: ServiceLevelObjective = {
  name: 'api_availability',
  sli: 'http_success_rate',
  target: 99.9,
  period: { type: 'rolling', duration: 2592000 },
  errorBudget: {
    alertThreshold: 80,
    burnRateWindows: [
      { window: 3600, threshold: 14.4 }  // 1hr window, 14.4x burn rate
    ]
  }
};
```

## Tracing Protocol (`tracing.zod.ts`)

- **W3C Trace Context**: Full standard compliance with 128-bit trace IDs, trace flags, trace state
- **OpenTelemetry spans**: Events, links, semantic attributes, instrumentation metadata
- **Sampling strategies**: always_on, trace_id_ratio, parent_based, rate_limiting, rule-based
- **Context propagation**: W3C, B3, Jaeger, X-Ray format support
- **OTLP exporters**: HTTP/gRPC with batching, compression, retry

```typescript
const config: TracingConfig = {
  name: 'production_tracing',
  sampling: {
    type: 'parent_based',
    parentBased: {
      root: 'trace_id_ratio',
      rootRatio: 0.1
    },
    rules: [
      { 
        name: 'always_trace_errors',
        match: { attributes: { 'http.status_code': 500 } },
        decision: 'record_and_sample'
      }
    ]
  },
  openTelemetry: {
    exporter: { type: 'otlp_http', endpoint: 'https://otel.example.com/v1/traces' },
    resource: { serviceName: 'api-server', serviceVersion: '2.0.0' }
  }
};
```

## Implementation Notes

- **LogLevel conflict resolution**: Existing `logger.zod.ts` exports base LogLevel; new protocol exports ExtendedLogLevel with 'trace'
- **Naming conventions**: camelCase for config properties, snake_case for identifiers (per ObjectStack standards)
- **Type derivation**: All TypeScript types use `z.infer` from Zod schemas
- **Test coverage**: 95 new tests covering schemas, defaults, validation, edge cases
